tree.heading: Delegation
tree.text: All authority vested in the Administrator by virtue of the provisions of this subchapter may with like force and effect be executed by such employees of the Environmental Protection Agency as the Administrator may designate for the purpose.

tree.heading: Cooperation
tree.text: The Administrator shall cooperate with Department of Agriculture, any other Federal agency, and any appropriate agency of any State or any political subdivision thereof, in carrying out the provisions of this subchapter, and in securing uniformity of regulations.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: For effective date of section, see section 4 of Pub. L. 92–516, set out as a note under section 136 of this title.
